title: KLH/BPLH latest reported station ISPU, 29 October 2026 16:00 source local time
referencePeriod: 2026-10-29 16:00:00 (source-displayed local time; timezone not explicitly printed on detail card)
updateFrequency: Live reporting; official method publishes PM2.5 indices hourly and other pollutant indices at least twice daily.
missingness: Six verified site values associate with five of 27 target regions; two sites are in Kabupaten Bogor. The other 22 regions have no accepted observation here, not zero pollution. This endpoint is not a census of all instruments. No 2023 history, station uptime denominator or monitoring completeness was recovered. Missing pollutant components do not establish that all pollutants contributed to the reported maximum.
definition: Source-reported overall short-window ISPU at each named monitoring site, accompanied by the source's critical pollutant. This is not a particulate concentration, administrative IKU or population exposure estimate.
measurementMethod: Public station index derived from pollutant concentration-to-index conversion under Permen LHK 14/2020. The regulation defines continuous 24-hour monitoring and hourly calculation; the displayed value and timestamp are transcribed without recomputation. Actual valid hours, calibration and QC certification for this observation were not exposed.
licenseOrUsageNotes: Publicly displayed government factual readings. No explicit storage or redistribution prohibition was found on inspected public surfaces, but no open-data licence was identified. Retain only narrowly attributed facts and short source receipts; this is not permission to bulk mirror the application or original data service. No authorization secrets were used or stored.

comparability.reason: Sparse heterogeneous monitoring sites, different critical pollutants and undocumented pollutant completeness do not support municipal rankings or 2023 comparisons. Exact transcription is reproducible from the stored attributed receipts, but live URLs change and historical API replay was not established.

temporalWarning: Actual observation is 29 October 2026, not 2023 or a nearby-year annual substitute. It is not comparable with 2023 CORE/context data and must display its full date.
limitations: Six sites, five associated regions; no region-wide mean is constructed.
Station names and addresses support site associations only, not regional population representativeness.
No verified 2023 station commissioning dates, archive, downtime or annual completeness.
The source timestamp is reproduced without inferring an unprinted timezone or an exact start time for its rolling window.
The Tegar Beriman overall index is a reported available-pollutant index; its zero particulate components are not certified as true clean-air concentrations.
Live URLs may later display different readings; preserved short receipts identify the observed snapshot.
knownBiases: Non-random station placement and sparse monitoring footprint.
A reported overall index can be driven by O3, SO2 or PM10 rather than PM2.5.
Unexposed pollutant components, sensor availability and local siting can affect the reported index.
safeStatements: At 16:00 source local time on 29 October 2026, the named station reported the preserved ISPU value.
The six observed sites associate with five CIVX regions; they do not represent all residents of those regions.
unsafeStatements: A municipality's population exposure equals its station's index.
Lower reported ISPU proves one municipality is cleaner than another.
The ISPU value is a PM2.5 concentration in micrograms per cubic metre.
All 27 regions have verified monitoring data.
The latest reading proves annual compliance or monitoring completeness.
statementTemplates: At {siteName} in {regionName}, KLH/BPLH reported ISPU {value} at {period}; this is a site observation, not a regional exposure estimate.

sources.title: Indeks Standar Pencemar Udara sebagai informasi mutu udara ambien di Indonesia
sources.representation: Researcher-authored audit receipt with attributed metadata/short excerpts
sources.evidence: Official explanation distinguishes dimensionless site-specific ISPU from concentrations and lists PM10, PM2.5, NO2, SO2, CO, O3 and HC. PM2.5 results are published hourly; other parameters at least at 09:00 and 15:00. Existing local primary-law excerpt was also read narrowly: Permen LHK 14/2020 Article 6 uses continuous 24-hour monitoring, and Article 7 requires completeness checks and removal of abnormal observations. Those requirements do not certify completeness or calibration of these six live site readings.
excerpts: ISPU merupakan angka tanpa satuan, digunakan untuk menggambarkan kondisi mutu udara ambien di lokasi tertentu
Hasil perhitungan ISPU parameter PM2.5 disampaikan kepada publik tiap jam selama 24 jam.
sources.retrievalMethod: Native reader on current official explanatory page; targeted jq selection of legal duration and quality-control lines in prior air-exposure audit. Current BPK canonical regulation record confirms the rule remains in force; direct PDF retrieval returned 403.

sources.publisher: JDIH BPK; Kementerian Lingkungan Hidup dan Kehutanan
sources.title: Permen LHK Nomor 14 Tahun 2020 tentang Indeks Standar Pencemar Udara
sources.representation: Researcher-authored audit receipt with attributed metadata/short excerpts
sources.evidence: Current canonical legal record states status Berlaku, enactment 13 July 2020 and effective date 15 July 2020. The linked PDF failed with 403 in this retrieval. Source law sets methodology, not station-specific data completeness.
sources.retrievalMethod: Native reader on canonical regulation record. No challenge links, headers or signed URLs retained.

sources.title: Public station endpoint access receipt
sources.representation: Researcher-authored audit receipt with attributed metadata/short excerpts
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated reader returned a JSON application status with code 401 and desc Unauthorized. The transport HTTP status was not reported and is not assumed to equal the JSON code. No key, token or authorization value was extracted or replayed. The ordinary rendered public application remained accessible, including station details. The root and webv5 URLs redirected to the application shell. No public 2023 validated concentration time series was recovered through these inspected surfaces.
sources.retrievalMethod: Native JSON reader without credentials; separate normal public Chromium navigation for displayed station data.
